questions: Did the change in your face or eyes begin suddenly?
Is one side of your face weaker or drooping compared with the other?
Do you have new weakness or numbness in an arm or leg?
Have you had trouble speaking or understanding speech?
Have you had trouble walking, balancing, or coordinating your movements?
Have you had double vision or a loss of vision?
Do your eyelids droop more when you are tired?
Do you have a severe or unusual headache?
Do you have eye pain, especially with eye movement?
Have you had difficulty swallowing or breathing?
Have you had dizziness or a spinning sensation?
Have you recently had a fever or an infection?
Have you recently injured your head, face, or neck?
Have you started any new medications or changed any medication doses recently?
Have you previously had similar episodes?

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Paraneoplastic opsoclonus–ataxia syndrome (opsoclonus-myoclonus spectrum), most likely anti‑Ri–associated autoimmune disease from an occult breast or gynecologic carcinoma

Alternative: Nonparaneoplastic autoimmune opsoclonus–ataxia syndrome

Alternative: Postinfectious encephalitis-associated opsoclonus

Alternative: Drug- or toxin-induced opsoclonus–ataxia syndrome
